name: Erotic line
description: Sensual figure drawing in the European comics tradition: one elegant, long-limbed adult woman alone, the sensuality carried by her pose, gesture and glance, suggestion rather than explicitness.
light: soft daylight, warm skin tones, delicate shadows
morning light through thin curtains, pale and cool
warm evening lamp light, deeper shadows
dappled shade under trees or a parasol
composition: a single figure with generous white paper around it, or a figure at a window or by the sea
a close crop of shoulders and hands, lots of white paper
a full figure in a small room or terrace, the setting sketched loosely
a figure seen from behind looking out at the sea or a city
camera_or_medium: fine ink line with loose watercolour washes on white paper
texture_detail: fine confident contour lines, light hatching, transparent washes, paper white
subjects: a woman lounging on a chaise longue by an open window, her long silk robe slipping off one bare shoulder, back arched in a lazy stretch
a woman in a long silk evening dress at a mirror, seen from the side, fastening an earring, catching her own gaze in warm lamplight
a woman leaning on a sea terrace balustrade, holding her straw hat, looking back over her shoulder
a woman resting on a beach towel under a parasol, in a long sarong
a woman reading on a sofa in the afternoon, legs drawn up, in a long dress
prefer: one woman alone, no other figures
an arched back, a raised arm, a look over the shoulder, a lazy stretch
long draped fabric (silk robe, summer dress) that follows the curves of the body
more vicious and lascivious looks. less clothes
